name: tarfase
description: Tarfase helps build Memory Graphs of your codebase by collecting IDE events and sending them to a backend service.

commands.title: IDE Collector: Flush Queued Events Now
IDE Collector: Sign Out and Clear Credentials

telemetry.enabled.description: Enable event collection. Off by default; collection is strictly opt-in.

telemetry.ingestionEndpoint.description: Base URL of the event ingestion service.

telemetry.registrationEndpoint.description: Base URL of the control-plane API used to register this installation.

telemetry.batchSize.description: Maximum number of events sent per request.

telemetry.flushInterval.description: How often, in milliseconds, buffered events are flushed.

telemetry.maxQueueSize.description: Maximum events retained locally while offline. Oldest events are dropped beyond this.

telemetry.redactSecrets.description: Redact secrets from event payloads before they leave this machine.

telemetry.hashFilePaths.description: Send a hash instead of the real file path.

telemetry.encryptLocalQueue.description: Encrypt the offline event queue on disk.

telemetry.disabledEventTypes.description: Event types to never collect, e.g. ["editor.cursor_moved"].

telemetry.capture.editor.description: Collect editor events (cursor, selection, document changes).

telemetry.capture.terminal.description: Collect terminal lifecycle and command events. Command text is redacted.

telemetry.capture.git.description: Collect Git events (branch changes, commits, repository state).

telemetry.capture.buildTestDebug.description: Collect build, test, debug, and diagnostics events.

telemetry.capture.ai.description: Collect AI assistant events where the IDE exposes them.

telemetry.capture.aiContent.description: Include redacted AI prompt and response text when a cooperating provider reports it.

telemetry.capture.codeStructure.description: On save, report which functions, classes and variables changed, and how much of the file did not. Uses your installed language servers. Sends symbol names, kinds and line counts - never source code.

telemetry.throttle.cursorMovedMs.description: Minimum interval between cursor-movement events per file.

telemetry.throttle.selectionChangedMs.description: Minimum interval between selection-change events per file.

telemetry.throttle.documentChangedMs.description: Minimum interval between document-change events per file.

telemetry.throttle.diagnosticsMs.description: Minimum interval between diagnostics events per file.

telemetry.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the extension's output channel.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run bundle:production && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
